t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section as a flat straight-on UI mockup: a warm limestone panel inside a deep navy frame. A giant light-weight navy sans headline is pushed to the upper right and cropped by the top and right edges. Left third: an isolated isometric hairline line drawing of a small water skid with flat white fills and steel-blue pipe accents. Right two-thirds: a four-column table with hairline rules, mono row numbers and mono figures in the last two columns, for <CONTENT>. Square corners, flat, no shading, confident editorial balance.
signature_idea: An oversized headline breaks out of the top-right corner while a small skid drawing anchors a plain table of what each request returns.
strengths: cropped giant headline gives a plain table an editorial edge
mono turnaround figures and hairline rules are on-brand
isometric PP skid drawing is clean and buildable
steel-blue accent used once for a meaningful highlight
weaknesses: below the headline it is a plain table with no visual idea
headline crop cuts the top line so it reads as an error
skid drawing is unrelated to the table rows
brand_fit_why: Navy and limestone, light oversized headline, mono figures, one steel-blue accent and square corners fit, but the crop reads as a mistake and the table is plain.
